2021: (1) National policy literacy forum on Youth Engagement Guideline developed by Ministry of Health; (2) National policy literacy forum and national advocacy workshop on existing young people's SRHR policies, laws and strategies in Ethiopia.2022: This includes: national advocacy network, consultation meetings with government stakeholders, policy literacy forum, and intergenerational dialogue amongst others2023 (second half): This includes national policy advocacy for gender responsive budgeting and a budget for gender clubs in schools, high level technical dialogue on harmful traditional practices, amongst others.

2023 (second half): Total 3. This includes gender-responsive budgeting at national level, policy literacy event and an intergenerational dialogue.2024: Total 15. This includes consultation on national youth policy, drafting teenage pregnancy roadmap and international engagements such as CPD, HRC and the Global Youth Dialogue in Benin.2025: Total 12. This included workshop on developing national SRH supplementary education manual and on strengthening Gender and disability inclusive budgeting as well as ask the Minister sessions.
